# Spatial datasets

Spatial datasets used by the BEACONs Project for conservation planning in the boreal.

## Up-to-date

**Hydrology**

- [National hydro network (NHN)](data/nhn.qmd)

**Topography**

- [Medium resolution DEM (30m)](data/mrdem.qmd)

**Landcover**

- [Landcover 2010, 2015, 2020 (30m)](data/landcover.qmd)

**Productivity**

- [Gross Primary Productivity (GPP)](data/gpp.qmd)
- [Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI)](data/ndvi.qmd)
